thread:
deploy-bot: Proposing temporary routing PIN: pin gateway routing-profile to gateway:v1.9.4-compat on prod-edge for a 90m window (23:45-01:15 PT). Reason: canary surfaced a signature-normalization mismatch after gateway v1.10 roll that causes ~1.2% customer 401s. Ticket INF-5239. Tagging @eng-platform and @ops.

maria: Can we see the canary snapshot and a short blurb for CS? need numbers for the advisory.

oscar: Canary canary-edge-20260510 shows 401 invalid_sig ~1.2% sustained over 10m after v1.10 landed; p95 latency flat. Root cause looks like header trimming change in the new gateway.

eng-telemetry: Dropped canary link + perf: https://telemetry.internal/streams/canary-edge-20260510 (401 spike)

ops-oncall: Ops can own rollback during window. What are auto-rollback triggers? I want thresholds we can wire into pause/play.

maria: Proposal: enable pin at start of window, monitor 401-rate and 5xx. Auto-rollback to previous gateway image if 5xx >0.5% sustained for 5m OR 401 rate climbs >3% sustained for 10m. Also suppress autoscaling during the observation period.

oscar: Runbook (if rollback needed):
```
# rollback gateway image
kubectl -n gateway set image deploy/gateway gateway=redwood/gateway:v1.9.3
# disable compat routing
curl -X POST https://routing.internal/toggles/compat-shim/disable
# validate
curl -f https://prod-edge.internal/health || echo "health failed"
```

eng-telemetry: I'll wire an alert: alert if 401_rate(prod-edge) > 3% for 10m or 5xx_rate > 0.5% for 5m. Will also add a telemetry tag header X-Compat-Routed=1 for routed requests so we can count impacted customers.

ops-oncall: Change window reserved 23:45-01:15 PT. I'll be on duty in #eng-oncall. If alerts fire, I'll follow the runbook and post logs here.

release-docs: I'll prep a one-line release note: "Temporary routing pin to gateway:v1.9.4-compat to mitigate signature normalization regressions post v1.10; see INF-5239." Will also add a customer advisory draft to the ticket.

maria: Thx all. deploy-bot, schedule pin and post status when applied.

deploy-bot: Pin action scheduled. Will attempt pin at 23:45 PT and post outcome.

deploy-bot: Pin applied at 23:46 PT: routing-profile pinned to gateway:v1.9.4-compat on prod-edge. Initial post-pin metrics: 401s down to 0.14%, p95 latency unchanged. Monitoring in progress.

maria: Monitoring looks clean after 15m. Ops keep window reserved; we'll unpin at 01:10 PT if stable and add follow-up to INF-5239 for long-term fix. ✅

deploy-bot: Unpin executed at 01:12 PT, routing allowed to roll forward. INF-5239 closed with follow-up: add gateway header normalization test to CI and ping major partners to upgrade their SDKs.
